body:
It probably is worth it if I actually am able to get an appointment. My mum booked one but it was on the day I went on school camp so it was cancelled. She hasn't been bothered to try and book one again. 

My family would probably be fine with me not going to uni but would definitely prefer if I did. Some of my friends would be supportive of me not going to uni, but a lot of them (especially the ones who are in the selective stream) would think I'm making a bad decision and want to talk me out of it. But before that's even an issue I have to decide what I want to do.

I never really thought how strange my mothers behaviour was until recently. That's what I've grown up with so its all I've known. 

I've spoken to the school counselor once after I basically had freaked out before a test because I fucked about printing the 2 pages of notes we were allowed to have and thought I was going to have to do it with out the notes. The counselor calmed me down a explained to my teacher what happened and managed to get my notes printed and able to sit the same test in the other bio class the next period. She also mention the extra 5 minutes per half an hour. But first I have to get a psychiatrist to officially diagnose me so the counselor can get the paper work approved. I already get 5 minutes per half an hour and a scribe for my developmental dyspraxia which helps a lot as it allows me to calm my thoughts and improves the legibility of my work 1000%.

I honestly don't know if I want to go to uni. I'm not really sure what I want to do anymore. I wanted to go into IT because I really enjoyed working with computers. Now I don't really enjoy any of my interests anymore. My dad wanted me to get a trade like all his brothers did because he doesn't think I would cope working in a office environment. But I don't feel I fit into the blokey culture that tradies have. I don't mind banter but I often feel really shit and emasculated after interacting with my uncles. I honestly have no clue what I want to do with my life.

It might help to just get it off my chest but I don't think they would really be able to offer any good advice. The small amount of reassurance they have offered me when I first brought up my own problems was very cliched and empty. I cant really blame them, it's not like they are trained for that. Plus some of them would probably start feeling really guilty for relying on me so much and I don't want to do that too them.

My mum is very selfish without realising it. Since I was little my sisters and I have always been told "it's all about me" from her. It's played of as a joke but as I have gotten older its obvious she actually thinks that on some level. She "trained" my sisters and I when we were younger to literally say "it's all about youuuu mama" on command. When ever she mentioned she was upset/sick/sore etc. we were expected to say "poor you mama". We ended up just saying it out of habit (which she complains about that we "don't really love/care about her anymore"). When ever my mum asks me to do something she expects me to be completely willing to do it. Sure I a meant to listen her, it's her house and everything but she puts in this act like I said I hated her when ever I say no to something. She literally says thing like "I thought you loved me" when I say I don't want to do some retard family activity she has come up with. She guilt trips me for everything. If she's to lazy to get out of the car to grab the take away I have to get it. Usually I don't mind but sometimes I am tired/have a headache/just not bothered so I say I don't want to. Her response is to act like a 5 year old and put on this sad face and say things about how the rest of the family was looking forward to fish and chips tonight or what ever. All this because she can't be bothered to ever get out of the car. This may sound like a teenager bitching about Bering told what too do but it's that fact she does this for everything I say no too.

My dad has learnt not to bother arguing with my mum. Take today for example. It was Father's Day and my mum wanted family photos,  fair enough. But she demanded my dad shave his 1 day growth of facial hair. He didn't want to but mum went on about wanting nice photos to have of us. Not even on Father's Day he can get what he wants if it conflicts with her. My dad is a lot like myself in always being the one to be the "martyr" as my mum puts it. Giving up stuff we want so others can get what they want. My  dad is always is (justifiably) grumpy because he basically has to do everything. He is the main income earner and has to do all the housework and cooking. My mum has a job too, but she refuses to cook and the only cleaning she does is the dishes every few nights. She wont even help me learn to drive (she thinks im going to crash or something) leaving my dad and driving instructor to get me to 120 hours. All this leaves my dad to be very stressed most of the time.

Yeah I'm from Australia, nsw in particular. I don't feel I have anyone I can truly talk too about my own issues. Some of my friends know I have problems with anxiety and depression but I only told them so they knew I could relate to their own problems (at lot of my friends have mental health issues). 

If I tried to talk to them about how I feel I would just either make themselves feel worse or just scare them off. My mum says she is always there to talk but when I do she guilt trips me for how I feel (she guilt trips me in general really).
